name: @minhduydev/pi-subagents
description: Herdr-native delegation runtime for Pi with durable task state, foreground/background agents, worktree isolation, claims/lease heartbeats, evidence and independent review gates, grouped completion, schedules, RPC v3, recovery, and SDK/tmux fallback. Runtime-only: agent profiles remain consumer-owned.
